context: Characterization first: capture current ledger payloads from the three direct tests. Delete only the unreachable mixin method. Do not call super() and do not move the recording wrapper back into the mixin.
description:
CONSOLIDATION DIRECTION IS MANDATORY. Do not start without reading this.

PlatformAdapter inherits ResultCaptureMixin (benchbox/platforms/base/adapter.py:105). The only production resolution of _setup_fresh_database_phases is adapter.py:1210. The mixin copy at result_capture.py:1792 is unreachable (mro[4], no other production subclass).

The copies have diverged in a soundness-relevant way:
- adapter.py:1245-1258 wraps create_schema in recording_connection(..., is_schema_tuning_statement) so schema-phase tuning DDL enters AppliedTuningLedger.
- mixin calls create_schema(benchmark, connection) with no recording.

The ledger contract (benchbox/core/tuning/applied_ledger.py) is: produced by the execution path, never reconstructed from config; capture must not break a run. Consolidating onto the mixin silently drops schema-DDL capture.

KEEP adapter.py:1210. DELETE the mixin method. FIX the docstring at adapter.py:1213 which currently says the mixin owns the historical implementation — that sentence is the harm path.

ClickHouse/StarRocks already record rendered schema clauses at platform render points; the adapter wrapper skips a second recording_connection for those (see the existing any(_record_tuned_sort_key_op / _record_starrocks_tuning_to_ledger) guard). Do not remove that guard.

result_capture.py is a CODEOWNERS soundness path; expect auto-merge withheld.

Independent of the composition ADR. Start now.

Stop condition: mixin method gone; adapter wrapper retained; schema-phase tuning DDL still in the ledger; ledger contents byte-identical on the existing capture tests.

anti_patterns.why: soundness artifact; capture must not break a run

anti_patterns.dont: delete adapter.py:1210 or replace it with super()
anti_patterns.why: that is the only copy that records schema-phase tuning DDL

anti_patterns.dont: fold cloud execute_query in this item
anti_patterns.instead: stop after the setup-lifecycle fork is gone
anti_patterns.why: that is arch-canonical-sql-execute-primitive and needs the ADR

anti_patterns.dont: move recording_connection into the mixin and have the adapter call through
anti_patterns.instead: keep the adapter-level guard as written
anti_patterns.why: ClickHouse/StarRocks would double-record and change the order-sensitive ledger hash

preserves.behavior: AppliedTuningLedger still records schema-phase tuning DDL for adapters that use the recording_connection wrapper
ClickHouse and StarRocks do not double-record schema DDL
External table mode still skips native schema/tuning

verifications.description: Adapter wrapper still records schema DDL
